Management attributed the mixed quarter to ongoing demand challenges, particularly in European sailings and a weaker booked position stemming from prior marketing and revenue management missteps. items.title: Norwegian Cruise Line rating cut at Mizuho after ‘self-inflicted wounds’
items.summary: Investing.com -- Mizuho downgraded Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NYSE: NCLH) to Neutral from Outperform and cut its price target for the stock to $17 from $22 in a note on Tuesday, citing rising leverage and the risk of a funding shortfall over the next 18 months.
